{{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Festive Swipe}}''' - The '''Evil Elf''' stops in its place and slashes its scythe at a tower, stunning it. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Evil Elf''' was an enemy that first appeared on Wave 20 in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a high amount of health, it moved somewhat quickly and had a high amount of defense. It had one ability, ''Festive Swipe'', where it stopped moving and slashed its scythe at a tower, stunning it. It was also immune to being frozen, slowed down and having its defense dropped by freezing towers, while also only being slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]], making it a very threatening enemy. It could be spawned by the [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability. ==Appearance== The '''Evil Elf''' was a hulking elf with pale-green skin. Its rig had lower arms and a waist. It had a dark blue shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black line going down the middle of its torso and waist, as well as down the sides of its sleeves. It also had black stains on its torso and upper arms. It had dark navy pants and black shoes. It also wore a dark blue Christmas hat. It wielded a red and white striped candy cane themed scythe. On the end opposite of the blade are six holly leaves. The blade itself is a yellow and red striped piece of metal wedged into the bottom of the candy cane. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] are recommended against this enemy. **These towers should have their firerate and range boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] respectively. **The [[Ranger]] cannot be stunned by the '''Evil Elf''', nor can the [[Engineer]]'s sentries be destroyed by it, making them both very effective. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse the stuns from towers stunned by the '''Evil Elf's''' ''Festive Swipe'' ability. *Slowing towers can be useful in delaying the '''Evil Elf's''' advance. **Freezing towers cannot freeze or slow the '''Evil Elf''' down due to its [[Freeze Immunity]]. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] are less effective against the '''Evil Elf''' due to its [[Stun Immunity]], only being able to slow it down as opposed to stunning it. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Jester]] are the only options that are unaffected by the '''Evil Elf's''' immunities. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] can be used to reduce the '''Evil Elf's''' defense. **Do note that as this enemy has [[Freeze Immunity]], it cannot have its defense reduced by the [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]]. *As the '''Evil Elf''' stops moving to use its ability, it is possible can use cheap towers like the [[Commander]] to distract the '''Evil Elf''', causing it to use its ability on the tower, stopping it from moving and buying more time to defeat it. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' -
